items.title: FM Sitharaman ready to hear out stock market tax debate
items.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman expressed interest in the discussions surrounding stock investment taxes and their implications. She mentioned that changes to these taxes are highly anticipated ahead of the Union Budget. Additionally, Sitharaman noted that the Reserve Bank of India is working to manage rupee volatility through specific measures. She emphasized the importance of maintaining strong economic…

items.title: Employee arrested after listening device found in OpenAI conference room, FBI and the company say
items.summary: Employee arrested after listening device found in OpenAI conference room, FBI and the company say

items.title: Oil Rally Peters Out With Mideast, Russia Tensions in Focus
items.summary: Oil held steady after three sessions of gains as traders booked profits from the recent rally while threats to energy supplies continued to loom from the Middle East to Russia.

items.title: US stocks: Nasdaq ends down as chipmakers fall and bank earnings roll in
items.summary: In a recent trading session, the Nasdaq index took a hit as chip stocks continued their downward spiral, amid diverging results from major banks like Citigroup and Goldman Sachs. The PHLX chip index faced a substantial decline, sparking fears surrounding competition in this sector. Despite the turbulence, analysts express optimism about future earnings linked to AI-driven innovations.

items.title: Oil Eases From Three-Day Gain With Focus on Middle East, Russia
items.summary: Oil held steady after three days of gains as traders booked profits from the recent rally amid persistent risks to energy supplies stretch from the Middle East to Russia.

items.title: Copper Slips as AI Selloff Saps Appetite for Risk Across Markets
items.summary: Copper wavered as traders weighed investor angst around overheated spending on metal-intensive AI infrastructure against continued supply risks.

items.title: Ircon to monetise 4 highway assets; PSU plans to unlock 3,000cr value as part of GoI's infra monetisation
items.summary: Ircon International has placed four highway assets for sale in a government-led monetisation programme. These assets include toll-road and hybrid annuity model projects located in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Karnataka, and Gujarat. The enterprise value of the assets is estimated to be around ₹3,000 crore, as advised by Axis Capital. Currently, Ircon is a Navratna company primarily earning from its railway segment.

items.title: Bihar joins Maharashtra, UP in curbing sale of non-subsidised fertiliser
items.summary: Bihar has imposed restrictions on the sale of non-subsidised fertilisers to control access for farmers. These restrictions could limit the availability of advanced crop nutrition products through existing distribution networks. Industry executives warn that this move may lead to significant losses and hinder investment in new technologies. Concerns have been raised about potential impacts on soil health and crop…

items.title: MSMEs need to focus on quality, cost to gain from new FTAs: Secy
items.summary: India's expanding network of free trade agreements is creating new opportunities for MSMEs to grow. The MSME ministry emphasizes the need for improved quality and cost competitiveness to access these opportunities. Moreover, government support for first-time exporters through practical assistance is crucial for success. It is essential to enhance certification participation and upgrade testing infrastructure to meet…

items.title: US Swaps Bets Backfire, Wiping Out Billions From Funds in Chile
items.summary: The pension funds used by millions of Chileans are racing to close out bets on US interest rates that backfired after the Iran war unleashed a global inflation shock, exposing them to billions of dollars of losses.

items.title: NY Fed President Williams sees no need for a rate hike in 2027
items.summary: At a recent conference, John Williams from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York expressed optimism about a potential interest-rate increase this year, suggesting inflation could hit the 2% goal by next year. He cited the role of artificial intelligence in affecting inflation rates while also addressing the sector's supply-demand imbalance.

items.title: Blackstone’s AI Data Center Deals Are Looking Shaky
items.summary: In a capital-intensive industry where money is the weapon that catapults startups to scale and overwhelms rivals, financiers can have a lot of sway.

items.title: Dividend, rights issue record date: Last chance to buy today - Shivam Autotech, Shraddha Prime, Anand Rathi Wealth
items.summary: Shivam Autotech and Shraddha Prime Projects have set October 15, 2026, as the record date for their rights issues. Anand Rathi Wealth also chose that date for its ₹4 interim dividend, after reporting 22% September-quarter profit growth.

items.title: KL Rahul-backed Boldfit secures $42 million to boost retail presence across India
items.summary: Founded in 2018 by Pallav Bihani, Boldfit offers a range of products, including sportswear, athletic footwear, sports equipment and fitness accessories.

items.title: Hyundai commits $15.5 billion to India, eyes global export hub expansion
items.summary: Hyundai Motor Group plans to invest $15.5 billion in India by 2032, funding research and development, expanded Hyundai and Kia production capacity, a vehicle testing facility and a dedicated investment entity. The company expects the programme to create jobs.

items.title: US bank earnings: How did JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, Wells Fargo perform in Q3?
items.summary: The results came after a turbulent quarter marked by the conflict in Iran, elevated oil prices and a global bond-market selloff, which affected dealmaking and trading activity across financial markets

items.title: US chip stocks slide as China’s CXMT advances; AI spending fears rattle investors
items.summary: Shares in US chip manufacturers tumbled, primarily influenced by memory and data storage firms, following competitive moves from China's CXMT. The sector faced significant pressure, stemming from concerns over escalating rivalry and demands for AI investments. Key players like Micron Technology, Seagate Technology, SanDisk, and Western Digital saw notable declines in their stock prices.

items.title: GST must become an economic partnership, not just tax collection tool: CBIC chief Vivek Chaturvedi
items.summary: Vivek Chaturvedi, Chairman of CBIC, emphasized the importance of reducing compliance burdens for GST taxpayers. During a recent meeting, various stakeholders discussed upcoming reforms focused on simplifying tax administration processes. Proposed changes include decriminalisation of certain offences and a higher threshold for prosecutions. The introduction of automated refunds and centralised administration aims to…

items.title: Toothsi parent MakeO raises ₹90 crore to expand dental care operations
items.summary: The company, operating across India and Southeast Asia, has crossed ₹500 crore in revenue and turned Ebitda profitable. It aims to double revenue in the next two to three years

items.title: Ashish Kacholia, Kotak Life lead Fusion CX’s Rs 315-crore anchor book ahead of Rs 702-crore IPO
items.summary: Fusion CX raised Rs 315 crore from anchor investors ahead of its Rs 702-crore IPO, with Ashish Kacholia and Kotak Mahindra Life Insurance among the participants. The issue opens on October 14 and closes on October 16. Swastika Investmart has assigned a Neutral rating, citing valuations and limited scope for re-rating.

items.title: NSEIX, London Stock Exchange sign pact to deepen India-UK market links
items.summary: NSE IFSC and the London Stock Exchange have signed an MoU to explore dual listings, cross-listings, new financial products and cross-border trading connectivity between GIFT City and London. The proposed collaboration could expand global investor access for Indian issuers, improve market connectivity and strengthen GIFT IFSC’s role as an international financial hub.

items.title: India announces two credit risk insurance policies to support shipbuilding industry
items.summary: The measures aim to protect shipyards from payment delays and financial risks while strengthening India’s maritime infrastructure and industrial competitiveness

items.title: Titan partners with Squarespace to offer custom-domain email to users
items.summary: Bhavin Turakhia-founded Titan will offer its Essential Email service to Squarespace customers at $3 per user per month, initially across the US, UK, Australia and Canada

items.title: Dr Lal PathLabs acquires remaining 30% stake in Centrapath Labs
items.summary: The acquisition consolidates ownership of the Indore-based healthcare and diagnostic services provider under PathLabs Unifiers, a subsidiary of Dr Lal PathLabs

items.title: Fashion brand Libas steps up retail expansion, plans 50-plus store additions in FY27
items.summary: The brand plans to scale the jewellery catalogue to 600–700 SKUs by March

items.title: J&K poultry farmers lose control as big companies expand
items.summary: Before 2019, the government levied a charge of around ₹9 per kg on poultry brought into the region, which farmers say provided some protection against supplies from larger producers in other States

items.title: AI arms race giving way to AI returns race: Aditya Birla Group chairman
items.summary: Aditya Birla Group chairman Kumar Mangalam Birla says businesses are taking a measured approach to AI investments, focusing on tangible returns, productivity and capital allocation

items.title: EPFO steps up drive for retrospective regularisation of exempt status of PF trusts
items.summary: Provisions for amnesty scheme were introduced as a transitional measure in the Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) Scheme 2026, notified on June 29 this year

items.title: Hyundai Motor Group to invest ₹1.47 lakh crore till 2032
items.summary: Investment includes last year’s commitment of ₹45,000 crore till 2030 — spans around capacity expansion, R&D, future mobility — for both Hyundai and Kia

items.title: Pesticides makers’ body CropLife issues advisory as Rabi sowing begins
items.summary: The industry body has mentioned about judicious use of crop protection products to save on input costs without compromising yields, CropLife said in a statement
